claim_status.evidence: The new results are stated as exact finite-genus identities. The Hodge quotient is asserted trivial on the labelled product only; 03_gluing.tex:106-109 explicitly allows a nontrivial graph-automorphism action. Defect allocation includes integer bounds and the empty-sum condition. The boundary argument uses algebraic normal-line self-intersection and pushforward, and the one-point logarithmic-kappa comparison is proved algebraically before the KMZ push-pull recursion is applied in Chow (04_boundary_and_forgetting.tex:105-123,215-226); no cycle-map injectivity is assumed. The tail lemma requires a positive cotangent power at every forgotten point, retains the negative sum of new psi classes in a kappa background, and is not used to erase that term. The exponential specialization derives its factorials and explains why the marking sum truncates at fixed genus. The roadmap, last paragraph and interface explicitly withhold uniform estimates for later genus-dependent summations and make no claim to prove the four asymptotic targets in this section.
